resources.string: Dictate a search using your microphone. Recognition uses the Android speech service and may need internet. It changes the search text without starting a call.
Open incoming calls automatically on the call screen. This is separate from showing photos full screen and remains subject to Android permissions and restrictions.
Turning off Wireless debugging and checking the recorder. Please wait for confirmation.

Free keeps essential calling features. Power Up adds contact and call productivity tools; Complete includes those plus automation and advanced appearance. The 30-day Complete trial has no automatic charge. Applied contact photos remain usable after expiry. dot.dictate needs its own license and API key.
